exact_quote: The goal of the semantic description of an instruction is to describe the results in all cases in as simple language as possible. The semantics are described using C, until C is not expressive enough.
context_after: 8694-8696: section heading 9.6.1. Machine-Specific Semantics of 16-bit Code
reason_for_inclusion: Shared normative context for BLOCK-1: states that the semantics of every instruction are described using C-like pseudocode. This frames how the add Semantics block 'd = a + b;' is to be read, but it does not state any overflow, truncation, or result-width rule for base add.u32; recorded so the searched context is traceable.
